registers.name: PORT
registers.note: the port registers P4-P31 (0x24-0x3F single, 0x40-0x5F eight at a time; Table 3, p.11-13): LED segment on / GPIO output level, power-up 0 (Table 4, p.15)

registers.name: RB
registers.note: what a read of a port register returns (Table 2, p.6): the pin level for a port configured as input, the stored bit for an output or LED driver; refreshed by the model on every pin or register change

commands.name: Write register: global current, configuration, mask, test, port configuration, segment currents
commands.note: addresses 0x02, 0x04, 0x06, 0x07, 0x09-0x0F, 0x12-0x1F (Table 3, p.11); the no-op 0x00 and every other address change nothing

commands.name: Read register
commands.note: the next 16-bit frame shifts out the command byte and the register: global current, configuration, mask, test, port configuration, segment currents (addresses 0x00-0x1F)

display.note: Table 2 (p.6): port configuration 00 = open-drain current sink that is on (pin low) while the port register bit is 1, 01 = push-pull output at the register bit, 10 = Schmitt input, 11 = input with pullup. Shutdown forces every port to an input without pullup, keeping the registers (p.7); the display test turns on every LED driver port and overrides shutdown for them (p.7, p.13); GPIO outputs are not touched by the test

devices.description: 8-digit 7-segment (64 LED) I2C LED driver: Code-B or no decode per digit, shutdown, display test (HEX decode, scan limit, blink, key scan not modeled)
devices.note: as1115 (PDF pages) p.3 features and ordering, p.4 pinout and pin descriptions, p.6 supply 2.7-5.5 V and 8-digit scan rate, p.12 slave address 0000000, p.13 command byte and read pointer, p.14-15 register map Table 6, shutdown Table 7, decode enable Table 8, p.16 Code-B and HEX fonts Tables 9-10, p.17 no-decode Table 11, key scan registers 0x1C/0x1D, p.18 test mode 0x0F, p.19 intensity and scan limit, p.20 feature register, p.24-25 packages, p.26 Table 25 ordering
